boundary: A two normal packaged App processes/windows with separate isolated profiles and source projects. Both use unchanged trusted main-renderer admission and actual preload/IPC/native/recovery/watchers. Peer capabilities are deliberately copied as required security inputs, not pointer actions. Positive edits/save/navigation use actual pointer/keyboard serially. I separately proves two authenticated synthetic sender identities in the same main service and same canonical file; this A does not claim a shared main service. Observers delegate original APIs unchanged, no auth replacement, fabricated result, store/editor/DOM-value injection, clipboard/model/CLI/external App/daily credentials.
